title: MMCFE: Context-Aware Multimodal Activity Recognition for Older Adults - code and simulated data
description: Simulator of Indian senior households, leakage-free evaluation pipeline, scripts that reproduce every table and figure, out-of-fold predictions and the Digital Twin export for the article 'Context-Aware Multimodal Activity Recognition for Older Adults: A Leakage-Free Evaluation on Simulated Indian Households' (IEEE Access, under review).
